key: Hello! We handle all employment requests here.
en: Hello! We handle all employment requests here.
ja: こんにちは! こちらでは求人のご相談をすべて承っております。

key: If you're interested in working at one of Sweet Co.'s lovely retail outings, please take an application, or fill one out online.
en: If you're interested in working at one of Sweet Co.'s lovely retail outings, please take an application, or fill one out online.
ja: スイート社の素敵な店舗でお仕事をされたい方は、申込書をお持ちいただくか、オンラインでご記入ください。

key: Would you like an application now?
en: Would you like an application now?
ja: 今、申込書をお渡ししましょうか?

key: Greetings, and welcome to Sweet Co.!
en: Greetings, and welcome to Sweet Co.!
ja: ようこそ、スイート社へ!

key: Sweet Co. is proud to offer a wide variety of both luxury and every day needs.
en: Sweet Co. is proud to offer a wide variety of both luxury and every day needs.
ja: スイート社は、ぜいたく品から日用品まで、幅広い商品を取りそろえていることを誇りにしております。

key: Although this building handles administrative work only, please check out our stores located on Main Street, or on 3rd and Hydrangea in the Lapis Ward.
en: Although this building handles administrative work only, please check out our stores located on Main Street, or on 3rd and Hydrangea in the Lapis Ward.
ja: この建物では事務業務のみを取り扱っておりますので、メイン通り、またはラピスワードの3番街とハイドランジア通りにある店舗をぜひご覧ください。

key: Greetings, customer!
en: Greetings, customer!
ja: いらっしゃいませ、お客様!

key: Sweet Co. is dedicated to quality service and quality products. We hope to make every visit to our stores an experience!
en: Sweet Co. is dedicated to quality service and quality products. We hope to make every visit to our stores an experience!
ja: スイート社は、質の高いサービスと商品の提供に力を注いでおります。ご来店のたびに、良い体験をお届けできればと願っております!

key: Please look forward to our newest shops, Sweet Tidings and Seasons' Sweetenings, opening in the Coral and Beryl Wards within the next year.
en: Please look forward to our newest shops, Sweet Tidings and Seasons' Sweetenings, opening in the Coral and Beryl Wards within the next year.
ja: 来年中には、コーラルワードとベリルワードに新店舗「スイート・タイディングス」と「シーズンズ・スイートニングス」がオープン予定です。どうぞご期待ください。

key: You lookin' to apply too? Some of these questions seem silly to me.
en: You lookin' to apply too? Some of these questions seem silly to me.
ja: あんたも応募しに来たの? この質問のいくつか、バカバカしく見えるんだけど。

key: Do you consider yourself an honest person?
en: Do you consider yourself an honest person?
ja: 自分は正直な人間だと思いますか、だって。

key: Uhh, I actually wasn't asking you. That's one of the questions on the form.
en: Uhh, I actually wasn't asking you. That's one of the questions on the form.
ja: あー、いや、あんたに聞いたわけじゃないんだ。それ、申込書の質問のひとつでさ。

key: But a dishonest person's always just gonna lie, right? So what's the point?
en: But a dishonest person's always just gonna lie, right?  So what's the point?
ja: でも、不正直な人間はどうせうそつくだけでしょ? だから意味なくない?

key: You wouldn't guess it, but I have a college degree.
en: You wouldn't guess it, but I have a college degree.
ja: 意外に思うかもしれないけど、あたし、大学の学位持ってるんだ。

key: But nowhere wanted to hire me because I'm too "overqualified".
en: But nowhere wanted to hire me because I'm too "overqualified".
ja: でも、どこも「オーバースペックすぎる」とかで雇ってくれなくて。

key: Hopefully this place will be different.
en: Hopefully this place will be different.
ja: ここは違うといいんだけど。

key: So the applications are back here, huh? Guess I'll give it a try.
en: So the applications are back here, huh? Guess I'll give it a try.
ja: 申込書はここにあるのか。よし、やってみるか。

key: Working in a candy store seems like it'd be raaaaad!
en: Working in a candy store seems like it'd be raaaaad!
ja: お菓子屋さんで働くのって、めちゃくちゃ楽しそう!

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
